tel_sla_contracts.description: Kestrava Telecom (fictional) enterprise SLA contracts: one row per contracted service with tier targets and monthly recurring charge. Fictional data.

columns.name: tier
columns.description: SLA tier: platinum, gold or silver.

columns.name: service_type
columns.description: Service type (MPLS VPN, SD-WAN, Dedicated Internet Access, Private 5G, Cloud Voice).

columns.name: sites
columns.description: Number of sites covered; availability is site-weighted.

columns.name: mrc_usd
columns.description: Monthly recurring charge in USD (base for service credits).

columns.name: availability_target_pct
columns.description: Monthly availability target in percent (platinum 99.98, gold 99.95, silver 99.9).

columns.name: restore_target_p1_hours
columns.description: Time-to-restore target for P1 incidents in hours.

columns.name: restore_target_p2_hours
columns.description: Time-to-restore target for P2 incidents in hours.

columns.name: credit_cap_pct
columns.description: Maximum monthly service credit as percent of MRC.

tel_incidents.description: Kestrava Telecom (fictional) enterprise service incidents 2025-11-01 to 2026-11-06 10:00 (one row per incident; open incidents have no restored_at). Site-minutes = outage_minutes x sites_affected; excluded incidents do not count against the SLA. Fictional data.

columns.name: incident_id
columns.description: Incident id, e.g. INC-2611-0047 (historical ids start with INC-H).

columns.name: month
columns.description: First day of the month the incident opened (SLA measurement month).

columns.name: restored_at
columns.description: When service was restored; NULL while open.

columns.name: outage_minutes
columns.description: Outage duration in minutes (to 2026-11-06 10:00 for open incidents).

columns.name: site_minutes
columns.description: outage_minutes x sites_affected (downtime budget consumed when not excluded).

columns.name: category
columns.description: Cause category: fiber_cut, hardware, software, config, power, ddos, third_party, planned_maintenance, customer_caused.

columns.name: excluded
columns.description: TRUE when excluded from SLA (planned maintenance with notice, customer-caused).

columns.name: restore_hours
columns.description: Hours from open to restore (NULL while open).

columns.name: restore_target_met
columns.description: Restored within the tier target for its severity (NULL while open).

columns.name: customer_notified_after_min
columns.description: Minutes from open to first customer notice.

tel_campaign_results.description: Kestrava Telecom (fictional) consumer marketing campaign results by week, segment and arm (treatment vs holdout control). Totals per campaign match the campaign scorecard. Fictional data.

columns.name: segment
columns.description: Customer segment: Young digital, Families, Price-sensitive, Small business, Rural fiber, Premium.

columns.name: targeted
columns.description: Customers assigned to this arm in the week and segment.

columns.name: responded
columns.description: Customers who responded (opened, clicked or answered).

columns.name: accepted
columns.description: Offers accepted (treatment) or organic conversions (control, cross-sell/win-back).

columns.name: churned
columns.description: Customers who churned within the read window (churn_save campaigns only).

ret_stores.description: Larkspur Home & Tech (fictional) stores. Fictional data.

columns.name: region
columns.description: Region: North, Coast, Central or South.

ret_products.description: Larkspur Home & Tech (fictional) product catalog: cost, list price and lifecycle per SKU. Fictional data.

columns.name: category
columns.description: TV & Home Theater, Computing, Audio, Smart Home, Kitchen, Gaming, Networking or Wearables.

columns.name: eol_date
columns.description: End-of-life date (successor launch); NULL for core items.

ret_inventory_snapshot.description: Larkspur (fictional) weekly store inventory snapshots (Fridays 2026-10-16 to 2026-11-06), one row per store and SKU. Days of cover = on_hand / avg_daily_sales_28d. Fictional data.

columns.name: on_order
columns.description: Units on order to the store.

columns.name: on_order_eta
columns.description: Expected arrival of the on-order units; NULL if none.

columns.name: avg_daily_sales_28d
columns.description: Average daily unit sales over the 28 days before the snapshot.

ret_sales_weekly.description: Larkspur (fictional) weekly unit sales by store and SKU, 12 weeks from 2026-08-10 to 2026-11-01, with promotion flags and margin. Fictional data.

columns.name: promo_flag
columns.description: TRUE when the SKU was on promotion that week.

columns.name: avg_discount_pct
columns.description: Average discount off list price in percent (0 when no promotion).

log_shipments.description: Halvard Logistics (fictional 3PL) shipments 2026-05-11 to 2026-11-06: delivered history plus the shipments active on 2026-11-06 07:00 (delivered_at NULL). Fictional data.

columns.name: shipment_id
columns.description: Shipment id (active ones look like HLV-SH-260552; history starts with HLV-H).

columns.name: shipper_id
columns.description: Shipper id: C-LRK, C-VAN, C-ORL, C-GRF, C-SBR, C-PNC.

columns.name: mode
columns.description: FTL, LTL, parcel, final_mile, drayage, ocean (reefer variants included).

columns.name: eta_at
columns.description: Current ETA for active shipments; equals delivered_at for history.

columns.name: delivered_at
columns.description: Actual delivery time; NULL while active.

columns.name: status
columns.description: delivered, in_transit, held, at_anchor, customs_hold, tender_rejected, picking, loading, delayed, out_for_delivery.

columns.name: on_time
columns.description: Delivered by the promised time (NULL while active).

columns.name: delay_hours
columns.description: Hours late vs promise (actual for history, ETA-based for active; 0 if early).

columns.name: exception_code
columns.description: WX weather, PORT port congestion, CAP carrier capacity, DC facility backlog, MECH breakdown, DOCS documentation; NULL if none.

log_lane_performance.description: Halvard Logistics (fictional) weekly lane scorecard 2026-05-11 to 2026-11-02, aggregated from delivered shipments: volume, on-time %, transit time, cost and claims. Fictional data.

columns.name: on_time_pct
columns.description: Percent delivered by the promised time.

columns.name: avg_delay_hours
columns.description: Average hours late across late shipments (0 if none).

log_dc_demand_daily.description: Halvard-operated DCs and the Vantor plant (fictional): daily demand and shipments per site and SKU, 2026-08-14 to 2026-11-05. Used for demand-driven replenishment. Fictional data.

columns.name: dc
columns.description: Site: AVD (Ashford Vale DC), RMD (Redmarsh DC), BRK (Vantor Brackwater plant).

columns.name: sku
columns.description: SKU or material (RES-ABS-PC is resin in kg).

columns.name: units_demanded
columns.description: Units ordered by stores, e-commerce or production that day.

columns.name: units_shipped
columns.description: Units shipped (lower than demand on stock-out days).

columns.name: stockout
columns.description: TRUE when demand could not be fully served.
